outputs.explanation: Panel shows a single deconvoluted mass spectrum (with peak masses and relative intensities) representing one measurement of cadmium binding to PacL1; no averaging, error bars, or replicate experiments are indicated, so replicate reporting is not applicable.
Panel shows a single deconvoluted mass spectrum for PacL1Δ5, analogous to panel A, with no indication of averaging across replicate experiments.

Bars show the proportion of protein species bound to 0–3 cadmium atoms as measured by native MS in a single spectrum per condition (as illustrated in A/B); there are no error bars, means, or statistical comparisons, and no replicate information is given, consistent with single-measurement population data rather than averaged replicate data.

Same format as panel C but for zinc binding; single-value bars per condition with no error bars or stated replicate numbers, indicating single-spectrum quantification rather than averaged replicate data.
Same format as panel C but for copper binding; no error bars or replicate statements, consistent with a single native MS measurement per condition.
Same format as panel C but for manganese binding; no error bars or replicate statements, consistent with a single native MS measurement per condition.

Chemical shift perturbation values per residue at 0.4/1.0/2 equivalents of zinc represent single NMR titration measurements with no error bars or averaging across replicate experiments; no replicate information is expected or given.
Same format as panel G but for cadmium; single NMR titration data per residue with no error bars or replicate statements, so replicate reporting is not applicable.
